newsitem.title: USA: America First PREP Fund 2 LP Q1 net off.
newsitem.headline: America First PREP Fund 2 LP Q1 net off.

text.p: America First PREP Fund 2 LP on Thursday reported first quarter earnings of $269,682 or $0.17 per Beneficial Unit Certificate (BUC), compared to $346,858 or $0.21 per BUC last year.
Revenues for the quarter ended March 31, 1997, were $356,723 versus $427,763. Book value of the Partnership was $10.67 per BUC at March 31, 1997.
The partnership's income was mainly from interest on mortgage-backed securities. It is paying monthly cash distributions to BUC holders at an annualized rate of about $1.34 per BUC.
